PROSPECTIVITY_ATTESTATION.why_that_ordering_matters: If the calibration METHOD were chosen after seeing the real distributions, the simulator could be shaped -- consciously or not -- into one the frozen estimator happens to pass. Freezing the method first means the ETL supplies numbers to a procedure that is already fixed.
what_this_document_does_NOT_do: it does not fit anything to the E2 correspondence result
it does not change the estimator
it does not change any nuisance family's scientific logic
PROSPECTIVITY_ATTESTATION.what_it_DOES_do: calibrate the SIMULATOR to the ASSAY, so the adversarial benchmark is run against measurement geometry resembling NIH-CARD rather than generic synthetic geometry.

MOTIVATION_FROM_MEASURED_MISMATCH.already_observed_outcome_blind: Real E2 promoter degree extends outside the historical synthetic support: 14.76% of edges have degree 1, below the synthetic minimum of 2, and 9.53% exceed the synthetic maximum of 11, reaching 29. About a quarter of E2 edges lie outside the simulator's promoter-degree range while the frozen IQR criterion still passes.
MOTIVATION_FROM_MEASURED_MISMATCH.interpretation_frozen_here: The historical span diagnostic is a MEASUREMENT OF SIMULATOR MISMATCH. It is not a threshold to be moved. The response is to build a simulator that covers the real geometry, not to widen a verdict rule.

ALLOWED_REAL_INPUTS.principle: outcome-blind ETL summaries only -- covariates, support, QC and geometry
list: NIH-CARD consensus peaks per E2 distal interval
linked and control geometry BEFORE any correspondence is computed
support and QC distributions from the declared-spent calibration material

FIREWALL_RULE: If any code path computes an E2 gene's RNA value together with its linked E2 distal element's ATAC value, that is a FIREWALL BREACH: stop and report it. The simulator must be calibrated without knowing whether E2 works.

CALIBRATION_METHOD_FROZEN_NOW.problem: Real nuisance variables are strongly dependent. Sampling them independently would destroy exactly the structure that can create false correspondence.

PRIMARY.name: EMPIRICAL_MARGINALS_PLUS_GAUSSIAN_COPULA
procedure: take the real 14-feature matrix computed for linked and control pairs in Stage 3 (covariates only)
estimate each feature's EMPIRICAL marginal via its observed quantile function, so marginals are reproduced exactly including tails such as degree 1 and degree 29
estimate the rank (Spearman) correlation matrix across features and convert it to a Gaussian copula correlation
generate synthetic pairs by drawing from the copula and mapping each margin back through its empirical quantile function
PRIMARY.why_this_choice: It reproduces every marginal exactly, including the tails the old simulator lacked, while preserving the observed monotone dependence structure. It is the least-assumption way to keep joint geometry without simply replaying the real rows.
PRIMARY.nearest_positive_definite: if the copula correlation matrix is not positive definite it is projected to the nearest PD matrix by eigenvalue clipping at 1e-8; the adjustment magnitude is reported

DECLARED_SENSITIVITY_ARM.name: DIRECT_ROW_RESAMPLING
DECLARED_SENSITIVITY_ARM.procedure: bootstrap whole real feature vectors with replacement, preserving the joint distribution exactly but unable to extrapolate beyond observed rows
DECLARED_SENSITIVITY_ARM.role: reported alongside the primary; if the two arms disagree materially that is itself a finding about the copula assumption

forbidden: independent marginal sampling of variables the ETL shows to be dependent
parametric marginal families chosen after inspecting the real distributions
any calibration target derived from correspondence

structural_geometry: promoter degree, including the degree-1 mass and the high-degree tail to the real observed maximum
the joint dependence among all of the above
donor_and_support_geometry: metacell-count distribution implied by the frozen target size of 25
cohort-depth relationship, which the schema receipt records as confounded
low-support and missing donor-edge cells, which must be MISSING and never zero
WHAT_MUST_BE_CALIBRATED.fidelity_standard: The simulator need not reproduce raw counts exactly. It MUST reproduce the parts of the assay geometry that can create false correspondence.

families_rule: The scientific logic of each family is unchanged. Only the geometry they act on is recalibrated. No family may be dropped because it becomes harder under realistic geometry.

ESTIMATOR_UNDER_TEST.primary: scripts/v63/e2_continuous_adjustment_estimator_v1.py, the frozen 14-feature continuous-adjustment estimator, IMPORTED UNMODIFIED
forbidden_during_qualification: adding basis terms of any kind, including polynomial, spline, sin or tanh
changing ridge alpha, the feature set, K_FOLDS or M_MIN
tuning the estimator per nuisance family
adding terms merely because the real geometry is broader
ESTIMATOR_UNDER_TEST.standing_out_of_span_rule: The estimator is already qualified ONLY within or near its frozen span (OUTSPAN_TECH failed at LCB95 -0.0356 against M_MIN 0.010). Broadening the geometry does not license broadening the model.

PRIMARY_QUESTION: Does the frozen estimator still reject technical worlds and preserve biological worlds when the nuisance and support geometry resembles NIH-CARD?

A.label: FROZEN_ESTIMATOR_STILL_QUALIFIES
A.meaning: every represented family retains one-sided LCB95 > M_MIN = 0.010 under realistic geometry, positives remain detectable, and support does not concentrate
A.action: report; the estimator's qualification extends to NIH-CARD-like geometry for the tested families

B.label: FAILS_ONLY_BECAUSE_HISTORICAL_SUPPORT_WAS_TOO_NARROW
B.meaning: failures are confined to regions of the recalibrated geometry that the historical simulator never covered, and the previously qualified regions still pass
B.action: report as a scope finding; do NOT patch the estimator

C.label: FAILS_MATERIALLY_ON_REALISTIC_TECHNICAL_WORLDS
C.action: STOP AND REPORT. A new estimator or basis requires a SEPARATE prospectively frozen successor design before any E2 correspondence outcome is opened.

D.label: SUPPORT_COLLAPSES_OR_PRECISION_BECOMES_UNUSABLE
D.meaning: linked pairs unscored, Kish ESS collapse, or concentration in a few donors/promoters
D.action: treat as a disguised support failure, NOT a pass, and report

no_improvisation_rule: Under any of B, C or D the response is a report, never an in-run modification. Improvising extra terms inside a qualification run is precisely the failure this whole contract exists to prevent.

MANDATORY_REALISM_RECEIPT.rule: No claim that a synthetic world is 'NIH-CARD-like' may be made without quantitative comparison.
required_per_variable: quantiles (min, p1, p25, median, p75, p99, max)
required_joint: largest absolute discrepancy in pairwise rank correlation

SEEDS_AND_CONFIGURATION.donors: calibrated to the real qualifying-donor count rather than the historical 18; the historical 18/24 configuration is retained as a comparison arm so the change in geometry can be separated from the change in scale
SEEDS_AND_CONFIGURATION.rationale: M_MIN is inherited unchanged. It is the synthetic-scale margin and this qualification is on the synthetic scale, so the transfer objection that blocked its use on real correspondence does not arise here.
